notes: Year 1 began 1 Nisan 521 in Babylonian reckoning.
title: King of Persia (Babylonian dating)

start_window.basis: Bardiya killed by Darius on 10 Bagayadi (29 Sep 522; Behistun §13); first securely dated Babylonian tablet of Darius's accession year 20 Shebat (4 Feb 521, Sippar) (Parker & Dubberstein 1942, pp. 12–14). The Babylonian revolts of Nebuchadnezzar III and IV interrupted recognition in 522–521.

end_window.basis: Last dated tablets of Darius 19 Tashritu year 36 (30 Sep 486) and possibly 27 Arahsamnu (7 Nov 486); first tablet of Xerxes's accession year 22 Arahsamnu (1 Dec 486) (Parker & Dubberstein 1942, pp. 14–15).
